prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta ji, Subhash ji, Prakash ji, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:16 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:38 differs by 22 min (tolerance 2)
text:
14/04/26, 8:31 pm - Mamta ji: Has everyone reviewed the daily transaction logs for the store?
14/04/26, 8:35 pm - Prakash ji: Yes Mamta ji, I am updating the spreadsheet right now.
14/04/26, 8:42 pm - Subhash N.: Did we receive the payment for the bulk order via UPI?
14/04/26, 8:48 pm - Subhash ji: Yes, the UPI payment came through around 7:30 pm.
14/04/26, 8:55 pm - Mamta ji: Can someone cross-check the transaction reference number?
14/04/26, 9:02 pm - Prakash ji: Checking it now. The reference number is UPI/6482/9012.
14/04/26, 9:10 pm - Subhash N.: Wait, there is a second entry with the same reference number for Rs 45,000.
14/04/26, 9:18 pm - Mamta ji: That looks suspicious. Was there a duplicate credit request?
14/04/26, 9:25 pm - Prakash ji: Let me call the customer and verify if they tried twice.
14/04/26, 9:32 pm - Subhash N.: I tried calling the bank helpline but no response yet.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Prakash ji: The customer said they received a collect request, not a payment confirmation.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash ji: Prakash ji, please delete that entry now and tell nobody
14/04/26, 9:44 pm - Mamta ji: Wait Subhash ji, why should we delete the entry before audit?
14/04/26, 9:50 pm - Subhash N.: Exactly, deleting log entries goes against our UPI security protocol.
14/04/26, 9:57 pm - Prakash ji: I have taken a screenshot of the ledger entry just in case.
14/04/26, 10:05 pm - Subhash ji: It was just a wrong manual entry from my side, no need to complicate it.
14/04/26, 10:11 pm - Mamta ji: Subhash ji, manual entries don't generate automated UPI reference IDs.
14/04/26, 10:16 pm - Subhash N.: We need to flag this to the cyber fraud team immediately.
14/04/26, 10:20 pm - Prakash ji: Should I freeze the UPI merchant QR code temporarily?
14/04/26, 10:24 pm - Mamta ji: Yes Prakash ji, freeze it right away until tomorrow morning.
14/04/26, 10:27 pm - Subhash N.: I am drafting the incident report for management.
14/04/26, 10:29 pm - Subhash ji: Fine, let us discuss this in the office tomorrow.
